content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Deoghar Research Associate-III Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 15-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Deoghar (AIIMS Deoghar) for the Technical Resource Centre.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name advertised in this notification is Research Associate-III under the DHR-funded project.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate-III position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 15 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to send their filled application forms along with necessary documents through email to the designated address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Research Associate-III?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 67,000/- plus HRA as applicable according to the guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per GOI norms.

faq.question: Q8. What educational qualifications are required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or equivalent postgraduate degree in health sciences, life sciences, public health, statistics, health economics, or related fields with relevant research experience.

faq.question: Q9. When will the eligibility list be published?
faq.answer: The publication of the eligibility list for the shortlisted candidates is scheduled to take place on 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification?
faq.answer: You can visit the official AIIMS Deoghar website at www.aiimsdeoghar.edu.in to download the application form and read the detailed notification.
